notes: Important upgrade-safety fix: Wingman will never again report a firmware upgrade as "committed/done" unless it has just read that live from the device. After "install activate" it now clearly tells you the box is still UNCOMMITTED with the auto-rollback timer counting down, and that "install commit" is required — so an upgrade can't look finished while it's hours from silently rolling back.
Clearer SSH drop messages (idle-timeout vs reset vs device-closed) and no more duplicate "disconnected" lines.
